objective: Corregir y completar el contrato puro de dominio Cavas para fuente financiera y modo integrado/standalone. No DDL, no persistencia de pagos real, no proveedor hardcodeado. Debe existir una sola fuente financiera de verdad por contexto contractual: INTEGRATED_TRANSACTIONAL_PROVIDER o STANDALONE_MANUAL. En modo integrado, Cavas no puede registrar pagos manuales y solo aplica transacciones homologadas provenientes del proveedor configurado. En standalone, puede registrar pagos manuales auditados. Nunca permitir ambos modos simultaneamente ni inventar transacciones.

import pytest

from modules.cava_socios.domain import (
    CavaFinancialMode,
    CavaFinancialSourcePolicy,
    CavaPaymentEvidence,
    CavaPaymentEvidenceKind,
    manual_payment_allowed,
    validate_payment_evidence,
)


def test_integrated_mode_forbids_manual_payment_registration():
    policy = CavaFinancialSourcePolicy(
        mode=CavaFinancialMode.INTEGRATED_TRANSACTIONAL_PROVIDER,
        provider_reference=\"PROVIDER-CONFIG-1\",
    )
    manual = CavaPaymentEvidence(
        evidence_kind=CavaPaymentEvidenceKind.MANUAL_AUDITED_ENTRY,
        amount=500.0, registered_by_user_id=\"USR-1\", audit_reference=\"AUD-1\",
    )
    assert manual_payment_allowed(policy) is False
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_payment_evidence(policy, manual)


def test_integrated_mode_accepts_only_homologated_transaction_evidence():
    policy = CavaFinancialSourcePolicy(
        mode=CavaFinancialMode.INTEGRATED_TRANSACTIONAL_PROVIDER,
        provider_reference=\"PROVIDER-CONFIG-1\",
    )
    evidence = CavaPaymentEvidence(
        evidence_kind=CavaPaymentEvidenceKind.HOMOLOGATED_TRANSACTION,
        amount=500.0, transaction_reference=\"TX-1\", source_system=\"CANONICAL-PROVIDER\", source_unit_id=\"UNIT-1\",
    )
    validate_payment_evidence(policy, evidence)


def test_integrated_payment_requires_real_transaction_reference():
    policy = CavaFinancialSourcePolicy(
        mode=CavaFinancialMode.INTEGRATED_TRANSACTIONAL_PROVIDER,
        provider_reference=\"PROVIDER-CONFIG-1\",
    )
    evidence = CavaPaymentEvidence(
        evidence_kind=CavaPaymentEvidenceKind.HOMOLOGATED_TRANSACTION,
        amount=500.0, source_system=\"CANONICAL-PROVIDER\", source_unit_id=\"UNIT-1\",
    )
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_payment_evidence(policy, evidence)


def test_standalone_allows_only_audited_manual_payment():
    policy = CavaFinancialSourcePolicy(mode=CavaFinancialMode.STANDALONE_MANUAL)
    assert manual_payment_allowed(policy) is True
    evidence = CavaPaymentEvidence(
        evidence_kind=CavaPaymentEvidenceKind.MANUAL_AUDITED_ENTRY,
        amount=250.0, registered_by_user_id=\"USR-1\", audit_reference=\"AUD-1\",
    )
    validate_payment_evidence(policy, evidence)


def test_standalone_cannot_also_have_integrated_provider():
    policy = CavaFinancialSourcePolicy(
        mode=CavaFinancialMode.STANDALONE_MANUAL,
        provider_reference=\"PROVIDER-1\",
    )
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        manual_payment_allowed(policy)
